scientific_annotation_recommendation.effect: Retain historical values as execution/log observations. Exclude from claims about a conservative loss-free physical HCA baseline or capacity superiority. Bytes/identity PASS is separate from scientific validity.
scientific_annotation_recommendation.remaining_17_cells: No accounting residual observed by this check; historical build identity gap and untested physical semantics remain.

findings.observed: All three detailed bags have both release events and successful planning events, one raw-ID completion, zero terminal active/unplanned tasks, and one raw-bag deficit. Their second successful plans precede the first exported planned finish. The completed raw count follows original events.
findings.inferred: Readable source reuses raw task_ID for EBS legs and overwrites saved_routes[task_ID]. This matches overlapping successful plans and missing route/completion records. Historic class SHA and epoch trajectories are unavailable, so the mechanism is strongly supported but not replay-proven; the physical leg completed cannot be identified from task-ID-only logs.
findings.high_load_scope: Other 40 positive-residual cells have terminal-accounting evidence only; individual root causes were not traced.
findings.normalization_boundary: No arithmetic evidence supports filling the missing raw bag. FIFO assignment of raw-ID completions makes segment-level labels ambiguous in overlap cases.
findings.not_a_horizon_queue: With zero active and unfinished tasks in the three detailed runs, queue persistence alone cannot account for their missing generated segment.

report_text_zh: 60个历史HCA控制格中，43格的 generated−completed−active_routes−unfinished 为正。南宁1×的3格各少1段；已存双段规划与单次原始袋ID完成日志支持旧执行器按raw task_id覆盖活动路径的解释。它们不是普通时域排队，具体未完成段的日志归属也有歧义。保留原观测、NA及配对值；不得将这些异常HCA格与其他方法的差值解释为无丢失物理基线下的容量优势。其余40格仅确认同类账目残差，未逐袋确定根因。

minimal_repair_assessment_read_only.possible_smallest_implementation: Assign a unique execution ID to each canonical segment in LegacyIcsNoFaultWindowBenchmark.readTaskList before HCA receives it, and retain an explicit executionID -> raw_bag_id/leg/OD mapping for logs/normalization. This lets existing route/reservation maps use distinct keys without changing A* formulas, route scoring or reservation timing equations.
caveats: This changes live execution identity and therefore resulting trajectories; it is not a retrospective reporting fix.
HashMap traversal/tie behavior must be acknowledged; an ID-only wrapper is an implementation candidate, not an already-proven equivalent correction.
It does not automatically add physical EBS storage-in -> storage-out precedence; adding that would be a separate semantic change.
Existing raw-ID logs cannot recover erased routes or counterfactual completion events; a corrected control would require a separately identified new execution.
Historical runtime class hashes are absent; static source and archived events support the mechanism but do not recover the loaded class identity.
